title: cert-manager-edit no longer lets namespace users create Challenges or Orders

detection.reason: the agent projects only the pod-subresource rules of a ClusterRole, so which API groups cert-manager-edit grants cannot be read; and tooling that creates Challenge or Order objects directly may not live on this cluster at all

quote: The `cert-manager-edit` aggregate ClusterRole no longer grants `create` for `challenges.acme.cert-manager.io` or `create`, `patch`, `update` for `orders.acme.cert-manager.io`. This fixes a security issue (`GHSA-8rvj-mm4h-c258`) where these permissions allowed namespace users to bypass Issuer solver selectors and abuse ClusterIssuer credentials.
remediation: If any tooling creates Challenge or Order resources directly — outside the normal Certificate → CertificateRequest → Order → Challenge flow — grant it those permissions explicitly. This closed a security issue (GHSA-8rvj-mm4h-c258) and is not being reverted.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterrole cert-manager-edit -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.rules[] | select(.apiGroups[]? | test("acme.cert-manager.io")) | "\(.resources | join(",")): \(.verbs | join(","))"'  # create on challenges, and create/patch/update on orders, are what the upgrade removes
coversNotes: Restrict Challenge and Order RBAC in `cert-manager-edit` ClusterRole

title: Issuers mint tokens for the cert-manager ServiceAccount, whose token RBAC 1.21 removes

detection.reason: matches the CHART DEFAULT ServiceAccount name; an installation that renamed the controller ServiceAccount needs the command below instead

quote: The Helm chart no longer creates a default `Role` and `RoleBinding` granting the cert-manager controller permission to create tokens for its own ServiceAccount (`serviceaccounts/token: create`).
remediation: Either create your own Role and RoleBinding granting `serviceaccounts/token: create` on the cert-manager ServiceAccount, or (recommended) move these issuers to a dedicated ServiceAccount with its own RBAC.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterissuers,issuers -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select([.. | objects | .serviceAccountRef? // empty | .name][0] != null) | "\(.kind)/\(.metadata.namespace // "cluster")/\(.metadata.name) sa=\([.. | objects | .serviceAccountRef? // empty | .name] | join(","))"'  # any row naming the cert-manager controller's own ServiceAccount breaks at 1.21

title: Removed prometheus Helm values fail schema validation — the upgrade refuses to run

detection.reason: Helm values live in the release secret and in your own repository, not in the collected inventory

quote: Because the Helm values schema uses `additionalProperties: false`, you must remove these keys from your values overrides before upgrading, or `helm upgrade` will fail with a schema validation error.
remediation: Delete `prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort`, `prometheus.servicemonitor.path` and `prometheus.podmonitor.path` from your values overrides, and rename any scrape config that selects the Service port `tcp-prometheus-servicemonitor` to `http-metrics`.
verifyCommand: helm list -A -f cert-manager -o json | jq -r '.[] | "helm get values \(.name) -n \(.namespace) -o json"'  # run each command printed and delete these three keys from what it returns before upgrading: prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort, prometheus.servicemonitor.path, prometheus.podmonitor.path

title: The controller Service's metrics port is renamed — scrape configs on the old name stop matching

detection.reason: the Service port name is projected; ServiceMonitors and scrape configs that select it are not collected

quote: The controller Service metrics port has also been renamed from `tcp-prometheus-servicemonitor` to `http-metrics`.
remediation: Change every ServiceMonitor or scrape config that selects the port `tcp-prometheus-servicemonitor` to `http-metrics`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get servicemonitors -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | .metadata as $m | .spec.endpoints[]? | select(.port == "tcp-prometheus-servicemonitor") | "\($m.namespace)/\($m.name)"'  # each row selects the old port name and scrapes nothing after 1.21; NO rows = clean
